title: Eggo SMP Mod
description: The official EGGO SMP mod, that is available for download!
body:
# EGGO SMP Guide
This mod is made for the EGGO smp created by Joshehh and swip_r.

# Crafting
You can craft Netherite Nuggets, which are just cosmetic

![Crafting Netherite Nuggets](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5baff9973a632da748e115940b198189d4cac50e.png)

You can use 9 of these to craft Netherite Ingots

![Crafting Netherite Ingots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d4a993c3777bdd98f60f3509b65d1840c2eae4d.png)

# Brewing
There is a brand new potion effect called MILK, and it will get rid of all potion effects except for Resistance, Absorption, and itself.

![Making the potion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7b4cf26da3ca0097640564dfec6cb12be3bad1a.png)

# Enchament

There's a brand new Enchantment for you to get. It's called Mace Protection; it will protect you from the Mace attack from above. It is only eligible on Turtle Helmets and is incompatible with Unbreaking (Unbreaking uncompatibility has been removed since 1.1 and later). It can be found in chests & enchantment tables.

![Turtle Helmet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d61b32d5e09bfbdee19e60018742da1a13cb0c4.png)


# Other Features

Netherite Armor, Sword, and Spear, upon being broken, will revert it's diamond counterpart.

Turtle Helmets act similarly to Diamond Helmets.
